mail.notes: Fresh Edge1 local acceptance confirmed mail.status.read and mail.draft.prepare with prepared-not-sent/no-send semantics. Phase 26 re-audited mail_threading and inbound_mail_hub: explicit thread-correlation metadata and minimized routing/audit records are not an authoritative persisted correspondence-body/thread store. mail.correspondence.read therefore remains intentionally disabled pending explicit selection and authorization of an authoritative native correspondence source. No live mail send is authorized by Unified Communications.

sms_mms.notes: Fresh Edge1 acceptance confirmed Messaging Gateway 0.4.2, authenticated messages.status.read/messages.conversation.read, BigBird prepared-not-sent draft behavior, explicit non-mutation boundaries, and durable PostgreSQL state. Phase 26 adds repository-ready private content-addressed MMS quarantine blob storage and a narrow trusted-scanner adapter interface with fail-closed tests, but neither the private storage root nor a genuinely trusted scanner runtime has been deployed and accepted on Edge1. MMS security therefore remains degraded and quarantine release remains unauthorized. Live carrier traffic is not authorized.

voice_sip.notes: Fresh Phase 19 Edge1 read-only functional acceptance passed for the telephony analytics surface: Asterisk, Kamailio, analytics and console services remained active; runtime analytics sources matched the canonical repository; the API remained loopback-only on 127.0.0.1:8099; aggregate endpoints and privacy validation passed; POST returned HTTP 405; and no calls, DTMF, routes, carrier configuration, database mutation, credentials, service restart or runtime mutation occurred. The analytics API reported overall_status=critical and sip=degraded, but source inspection shows those values are derived from repository file data/registry/interconnect/status/peer-status.json rather than a live peer probe. The current repository snapshot was last checked 2026-07-20 and marks lab-carrier-001-peer failed with a name-resolution error. Therefore current live Voice/SIP operational health is not established by Phase 19 and edge1_runtime remains unknown rather than degraded. PR #414 later accepted the local Asterisk/PJSIP transport repair without establishing external carrier/interconnect health. This acceptance does not authorize call origination, emergency routing, trunk, route, or dialplan mutation.

communications_relay.notes: Fresh Phase 14J Edge1 acceptance confirmed edge1-comms-relay as the authoritative native metadata source for the unified workspace. The read-only/query-only snapshot generator produced and validated 168 canonical Relay/NNTP events, the live workspace returned all 168 with authoritative native provenance and untrusted-content handling, POST remained HTTP 405, and the 15-minute refresh timer is enabled. The native database remains mode 0600 and no upstream posting/federation mutation is authorized.

communications_workspace.notes: Fresh Edge1 acceptance confirms the persistent wwcx-communications-workspace.service bound only to 127.0.0.1:8095 with an attached authoritative Relay canonical snapshot. Phase 14J returned 168 canonical events, preserved content_is_untrusted=true and mutation_authorized=false, rejected POST with HTTP 405, enabled a 15-minute snapshot refresh timer, kept the live repository worktree unchanged, and retained rollback evidence. No reverse proxy/public exposure is authorized.

private_ai.notes: Fresh Edge1 acceptance confirmed BigBird 0.3.4-alpha.3 in read-only mode with eight registry tools, including messages.conversation.read and messages.draft.prepare. Missing-scope authorization failed closed, unsigned /v1/chat returned HTTP 401, messaging control remained disabled, and protected rollback was retained. Historical communications.read and telephony.read remain separate accepted capabilities. No privileged execution or production traffic authority is granted.
